about: Dynasty Manager promo (Isac's football manager game, github.com/Wrexist/dynasty-manager). 9:16 animated stickman short with the motion kit: a manager is hired by the worst club, has no money, scouts a wonderkid, sets tactics, wins in the last minute, climbs the leagues, opens free packs. Facts from the repo's APP_STORE_LISTING.md (45+ divisions, 51 nations, 11 formations, daily free packs, no energy timers). No real club, league or player names. Chatterbox voice, no music.

lines.text: By the worst club in the whole league.
lines.say: By the worst club... in the whole league.

lines.text: So you find a seventeen-year-old nobody wanted.
Pick a formation. Set the press, the tempo, the width.
Free packs every day. No energy timers.
Which club are you saving first?
